experiments.name: Crash Before Majority Commit
experiments.description: Coordinator logs proposal at index 1, term 1, but crashes before quorum acknowledgment.
experiments.outcome: Entry remains uncommitted; commit_index stays 0; recovered standby ignores uncommitted entry.

experiments.name: Crash After Majority Commit
experiments.description: Log entry replicated to 2 of 3 voters and committed (commit_index 1). Coordinator restarts.
experiments.outcome: Committed entry survives restart completely intact; commit index is restored from durable WAL.

experiments.name: Conflicting Leaders Proposal Rejection
experiments.description: Deposed leader presents AppendEntries with Term 1 to replica at Term 2.
experiments.outcome: Replica rejects proposal: request term 1 < local term 2.

experiments.name: WAL Replay and State Machine Recovery
experiments.description: ReplicatedLogManager crashes after 5 committed entries and reboots.
experiments.outcome: Full WAL replay recovers all entries up to index 5; committed manifest generations restored.

experiments.name: Snapshot Installation Rollback Prevention
experiments.description: ReplicatedLogManager at commit index 10 receives snapshot with index 5.
experiments.outcome: Snapshot installation strictly rejected with CorruptMetadata (snapshot rollback rejected: index 5 < commit index 10).
